_comment: Published versions map to immutable cut commits and annotated tags. Historical rows and tag targets stay unchanged. The optional preparing object contains only version and cut_date for the sole newest heading; it claims no published release. After authorized tagging, a later provenance commit moves it into releases with the existing cut SHA and clears preparing. See docs/ops.md for preparation, cut, tagging, provenance and recovery.
